Explain a software test to a new teammate using a concrete analogy. Be concise and avoid hype.

Think of a software test as a rehearsal before a performance. It checks expected behavior before people depend on it. The analogy gives you a starting point; the details depend on how the system is built. Start with a small example, then explore what happens when the input changes.
